It addresses cross-border education and mutual recognition of qualifications within the medical field. The paper mentions the East African Community (EAC) as a regional framework.",

  "KEY_FINDINGS": {
    "Main_Findings": [
      "Harmonization of medical education in East Africa has the potential to improve the quality and relevance of medical training.",
      "Harmonization can facilitate the mobility of medical professionals within the region.",
      "Harmonization can promote the development of a common East African identity among medical professionals."
    ],
    "Challenges_Barriers": [
      "Lack of political will",
      "Inadequate funding",

      "Adequate funding",
      "Effective communication and collaboration among stakeholders",
      "Development of clear and transparent guidelines"

      "Developing clear and transparent guidelines for harmonization",
      "Promoting effective communication and collaboration among stakeholders"

      "Further research is needed to evaluate the impact of harmonization on the quality of medical care in East Africa.",
